meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 记忆服务:默认在本机运行 worker 加 CMEM Pro 观察器,监听各 agent 的对话记录,任务开始时经 MCP 注入上下文,并把实时索引写入 memory/log 注入文件。不需要 Cursor、xAI key 或 Claude CLI。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装或配置 claude-mem 时触发。默认路径无需额外参数,只有想用回环 shim 时才加 --provider host。

say.text: 用 --provider host 装本地主机登录观察器
say.note: 这是显式可选路径,不是默认

say.text: 配置 cmem.ai 的远程 worker 和观察器

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Grok Bot: a local worker plus CMEM Pro observer watches each agent's transcripts, injects context via MCP at task start, and writes a live index into the agent's memory/log file. No Cursor, xAI key, or Claude CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up claude-mem on Grok Bot. The default path needs no extra flags; only add --provider host if you want the loopback shim.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default CMEM Pro observer
Install it with --provider host for the local host-login observer
say_en.note: Opt-in loopback shim, not the default

say_en.text: Set up the remote worker and observer at https://cmem.ai
